newsitem.title: USA: Catalytica jumps on Glaxo Wellcome deal.
newsitem.headline: Catalytica jumps on Glaxo Wellcome deal.

text.p: Shares of Catalytica Inc rose sharply after the Mountain View, Calif., company said it agreed to buy Glaxo Wellcome Plc's pharmaceutical production plant in North Carolina.
Catalytica also has a potential five-year contract to manufacture Glaxo Wellcome prescription products, which may be worth as much as $800 million in revenue during that period, the company said.
The contract would mean a financial windfall for Catalytica, which had revenues of $16.3 million in 1996.

"This deal has huge potential for them. They had been looking for a manufacturing facility to exploit their catalytic technology. Now they have a state-of-the-art facility, plus guaranteed contracts to keep growing," said Robert Kruger, an analyst with Van Kasper & Co.

In addition to the potential Glaxi pact, Catalytica said it has product development agreements with more than a dozen major pharmaceutical companies, including Pfizer Inc and Pharmacia & Upjohn PHU.N. (( -- Wall Street desk 212-859-1730))
